2	export const CURRENCY = "USD";

4	// Calculate a discounted basket total.
5	export function computeTotal(items, discount = 0) {
6	  const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0);
7	  return Math.round(subtotal * (1 - discount) * 100) / 100;
8	}
9	
10	export function isEligible(user) {
11	  return user.active && user.age >= 18;
12	}
